newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asia-Pacific economies to seek forex stability - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Asia-Pacific economies to seek forex stability - MOF.

text.p: Senior officials from five Asian nations and the United States on Tuesday shared the view that close contacts are needed to ensure the stability of currency and other financial markets, a senior Japanese Finance Ministry official told a news conference.
The officials met in Tokyo for a "Six Markets" forum grouping the United States, Japan, Australia, China, Singapore and Hong Kong.

Takatoshi Kato, vice minister for international affairs at Japan's Finance Ministry, who chaired the meeting, said they did not discuss specific schemes to cooperate on currencies, financial markets, macroeconomic policies and other issues.
"The main purpose of the meeting was to exchange information about each other's financial, currency and capital markets," he said.
"It was just a first meeting so no specific measures were discussed."

Kato told the news conference: "We spent a lot of time exchanging information about each other's economies and financial markets and have recognised the importance of keeping close contacts to seek stability in those markets."
The participants did not discuss whether the meeting should include other Asian markets or whether it should be upgraded to ministerial level, he said.
